decision: PASS for updated scoped source changes, native results-jump reasoning and isolated behavioral acceptance. No unresolved P1/P2 finding. Root actual-browser and release gates remain separate.

findings.topic: Ready means a usable public link
findings.finding: Renderer marks ready only when crosswalk.status is confirmed and its registry_id is in the actual public model. The same boolean controls the profile href, so ready attributes and links cannot diverge within entry(). Unreviewed/nonpublic confirmed rows remain pending with no researched-profile href.

Existing visible_entries canonical hide_nation/takedown and directory-hold filtering remains unchanged and precedes rendering. Both canonical hide/takedown fixtures pass. Static rows remain in HTML before JS, and filtering does not create or restore entities, facts, preferred names or identity approvals.

Ready mode requires enhanced markup and an existing checked native checkbox. It composes with query and source through AND; absent checkbox keeps previous behavior. Checkbox/source/query events reset the 40-row batch. Clear clears only query and preserves both source and checkbox.

Active status says matching name records with reviewed profile links, not Nations or all canonical profiles. The hidden-until-active hint clarifies directory-link coverage and links directly to /nations#find, preserving discovery of researched profiles whose directory links are still pending.

Show More uses the existing 40-row progression and first-new-name focus. Valid inventory anchors and row hashes reset ready/query before revealing the requested target, including pending rows. Malformed hashes return before mutation. Initial deep links preserve no-focus-on-load behavior.

A real input[type=checkbox] has an explicit and wrapping native label, aria-controls and descriptive hint. CSS preserves default keyboard operation and global focus outline. Native box is declared22px inside a clickable label with min-height48px; this source review does not claim the box itself is44px. Added rules use existing theme ink/background conventions and add no animation, transition or extra dependency.

Seven executable pytest cases passed in this independent rerun. The new Node fixture executes the actual production directory IIFE, marks fictional rows, and asserts interaction outcomes; it does not copy the filter algorithm. Renderer tests separately assert ready/href agreement and absence under canonical holds. Both copied acceptance files match prebuild artifact hashes exactly. Original legacy Node fixture is byte-unchanged and passes.

New native Browse Matching Names anchor targets the existing unscoped #directoryNames container. It has tabindex=-1 and scroll-margin88px; link min-height44px. Directory hashTarget accepts this container but reveal() returns at missing inventory owner before any query/source/checkbox/focus mutation. An isolated production-script fixture confirms all filter/result state remains identical and no custom inventory focus/scroll is forced. Native fragment focus/scroll remains a real-browser check. The explanatory material now appears in a native Understand These Records details element; full text, counts, pending-link explanation and all-profile resource links remain in HTML and accessible without JS.

pytest.result: Seven acceptance cases pass after the native results-jump addition and explanatory disclosure change.

measured_tests.prebuild_baseline: The same new acceptance previously measured5failed/2passed before implementation; no future passing result was manufactured.
measured_tests.runtime_note: Unrelated pyreadline console destructor warning appears after successful pytest results; retained in log.

results_jump.result: Ready checkbox, query, source, status, hint, shown rows and pagination remain identical across #directoryNames hash; script does not override native fragment focus/scroll.

remaining_verification: Actual native Space interaction, visible keyboard focus and label hit area in root-owned browser.
Measured responsive overflow/wrapping and clickable label size at phone/tablet/desktop widths.
Actual rendered native checkbox appearance across all four site themes; source-level use of tokens alone is not browser contrast certification.
Build, content, hold, CSP and publication checks for the full batch.
Root actual-browser activation of Browse Matching Names should move native focus/scroll to #directoryNames while preserving ready/query/source state.
limits: No new browser or physical-device check by this reviewer. Source and fixture review is not screen-reader, native OS, real phone or all-browser certification.
The ready filter intentionally covers reviewed directory-to-profile links. Other existing canonical profiles may not yet be linked and must remain discoverable via the hint.
This UI review does not approve new Nation facts, identity matches, rights claims or Mattaponi source reuse.
